name: Web Application Security
purpose: Prevent OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, Injection, SSRF, Broken Auth).
inputs: Web routes, trust boundaries, and browser security requirements
Authentication, session, upload, and outbound-request flows
Response headers, CSP reports, and dependency policy
outputs: Web boundary findings for XSS, CSRF, SSRF, uploads, and CORS
Header, cookie, redirect, and request-validation remediation
CSP, browser, request, and regression-test evidence
stop_conditions: Browser and request security regressions pass for XSS, CSRF, SSRF, upload, and redirect paths
